svg.title: mh@wasikarn runtime workflow: user prompt flows through five lanes — user, model, hooks, catalog, verify — with the PreToolUse dispatcher as the irreversible boundary.
svg.desc: A five-lane swimlane showing one happy-path session. The user sends a prompt. The model — a single Claude model by default, or the separate opt-in mh:tiered-pipeline skill — invokes skills or agents and is bound by the PreToolUse dispatcher, which is one registration that fans out to thirteen gate rules in a table and merges strictest-wins. Seven advisory sensors journal after each tool call. The catalog lane holds 17 agents, 59 skills, and the workflow/hook scripts that back them. On commit, a pre-commit gate runs fast checks before pre-push gauntlet runs six validation layers. A callout notes that compliance-audit and deep-audit run on fresh context and are not auto-fired in the runtime loop.

g.text: to user · or to next tool
